title: Investigation of the Audible ICD Alert Tone
official: Investigation of the Audible Alert Tone in ICD Patients with Subcutaneous Cardioverter Defibrillators
summary: Ability of ICD patients to hear the audible ICD alert is being assessed.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patient equipped with a subcutaneous ICD
* willing to participate

Exclusion Criteria:

* S-ICD implantation within the past 3 weeks
* patient is deaf
